name: Leaf Tuck
blurb: Folds itself into the nearest red leaf pile.

name: Cob Scout
blurb: Counts rows of kernels to keep from getting lost.

name: Kernel Knock
blurb: Knocks twice, then pops with excitement.

name: Stitch Crow
blurb: A scarecrow’s apprentice, very serious about hats.

name: Golden Ring
blurb: A hole shaped like a good harvest.

name: Popcorn Moon
blurb: Rises over the field and goes pop at midnight.

name: Palm Fidget
blurb: Cannot sit still when the breeze is fresh.

name: Tide Tuck
blurb: Tucks itself into the sand just before a wave.

name: Coral Cuff
blurb: Four tiny reefs on four small knobs.

name: Lagoon Loop
blurb: A hole in the picture where a lagoon winks.

name: Hammock Hush
blurb: Hangs upside down for hours and calls it thinking.

name: Bromeliad Bolt
blurb: Keeps a cup of rain in its spiky crown and shares it with nobody.

name: Highland Ring
blurb: A cloud-cold hoop that claims to be the highest hoop in the world.

name: Skerry Seal
blurb: Barks at the lighthouse and waits for a fish to be invented.

name: Peat Sip
blurb: Puffs warm smoke over the cottage roof and hums about tea.

name: Kite Knot
blurb: Ties its tail in a bow and flies off in a huff.

name: Net Nudge
blurb: Mends one net a day and nudges the fish towards the quay.

name: Olive Pip
blurb: Grew up in an olive grove and still thinks every tree is hers.

name: Jar Hum
blurb: Hums at the oil jars until they hum back.

name: Sun Glint
blurb: Winks off the sea at breakfast and keeps going all afternoon.

name: Press Ring
blurb: A stone hoop that squeezes the most golden oil in town.

name: Harbour Leap
blurb: Leaps the breakwater and lands in the same bay every time.

name: Slushbelly
blurb: Melts a little every time somebody is looking.

name: Gander Gait
blurb: Marches in a neat line and expects everyone to follow.

name: Samovar Puff
blurb: Steams up the porch and pours tea nobody asked for.

name: Catkin Crown
blurb: Wears a crown of catkins and sneezes gold when pleased.

name: Chimney Nest
blurb: A stork’s nest on a chimney, and a stork who never moves out.

name: Homing Stork
blurb: Knows the way home from anywhere and never asks directions.

name: Sherbet Sip
blurb: Pours mint tea from very high up and hopes nobody spills.

name: Scarab Roll
blurb: Rolls a tiny ball of sand across the dunes at a steady pace.

name: Lantern Lark
blurb: Sings to the lantern strings until the sky turns violet.

name: Canyon Crown
blurb: Wears a rose-red crown of cliff and never takes it off.

name: Oasis Hoop
blurb: Floats in the oasis pool and keeps a date for every friend.

name: Mirage Moon
blurb: Shines over the dunes and makes the camels blink.

name: Calabash Cup
blurb: A gourd that catches roof rain and passes it along politely.

name: Drum Tap
blurb: Taps a rhythm on the pavilion and gets the rain to join in.

name: Yam Nub
blurb: A knobbly root that giggles whenever it is dug up.

name: Shellstep
blurb: Takes a very slow walk to the stall and still arrives on time.

name: Canopy Loop
blurb: Swings from bridge to bridge and says good morning to every parrot.

name: Parrot Pennant
blurb: Repeats everything the rain says, then shouts it louder.

name: Coffee Crumb
blurb: Roasts the beans with great care and a very large hat.

name: Flamingo Flick
blurb: Stands on one leg in the waterhole and dares you to try.

name: Termite Tower
blurb: Builds a red tower one grain at a time and never says sorry.

name: Acacia Antler
blurb: Grows antler-like twigs and hangs weaver nests from every one.

name: Kopje Keeper
blurb: Keeps a stony watch over the savanna and never once blinks.

name: Tall Tiptoe
blurb: Reaches the top leaves before anybody else is out of bed.

name: Saffron Snip
blurb: Snips saffron threads with tiny scissors and hums while picking.

name: Yak Yonder
blurb: Leads a laden yak across the bridge, because yonder is always further.

name: Chilli Chime
blurb: Hangs chilli garlands that tinkle whenever the wind comes through.

name: Stupa Snug
blurb: Sits snug under a white dome and keeps the prayer flags tidy.

name: Teal Ferry
blurb: Ferries flower boats down the teal river and waves at every fish.

name: Lofty Kite
blurb: Flies high over the ridge and always looks down on everything.

name: Petal Pinch
blurb: Pinches one pink petal from every tree and keeps them in a pocket.

name: Koi Kin
blurb: Swims round the koi pond with a great many cousins, all orange.

name: Panda Puff
blurb: A fluffy bamboo fan who eats one stalk at a time, very slowly.

name: Pagoda Pin
blurb: Points to the top of the pagoda and says it was up there first.

name: Torii Loop
blurb: Hops through every red gate on the stairs and comes back for more.

name: Dragon Dart
blurb: Darts over the koi pond on paper wings and winks at the Long Wall.

name: Stilt Stoop
blurb: Lives up on stilts and waves at the canal every morning.

name: Seedling Plod
blurb: Plods through the paddy one seedling at a time and sings to each.

name: Lotus Lump
blurb: Floats on the canal and sleeps through the whole downpour.

name: Sky Lantern
blurb: Drifts up at dusk and tells the rain to hurry along.

name: Fig Knot
blurb: Wraps itself round the temple and never lets go of a secret.

name: Bill Brolly
blurb: Carries a giant leaf for an umbrella and shares it with the nearest frog.

name: Snorkel Snip
blurb: Snorkels the reef with a shell in each hand and no plan at all.

name: Octo Ogle
blurb: Ogles every shiny thing in the lagoon and then stares some more.

name: Anemone Nudge
blurb: Nudges the clownfish home whenever they wander too far.

name: Claw Sail
blurb: Sails the outrigger with a crab-claw sail and a very large grin.

name: Grotto Glim
blurb: Glows with the glowworms in the cave and whispers ooh.

name: Keel Drift
blurb: Glides past the reef with a slow wink and a very old shell.

name: Rime Crumb
blurb: A crumb of frost the toad coughed up, still croaking softly.

name: Puddle Croak
blurb: Sits in a cold puddle and hums a lullaby for toads.

name: Thawdrop Pip
blurb: A drop of spring meltwater saved from the toad’s last yawn.

name: Frostwart Bumps
blurb: Four frosty warts off the toad’s back that go bump in the cold.

name: Barrow Peephole
blurb: A peephole in the old barrow door, frosty round the edges.

name: Barrow Icecrown
blurb: The frost toad’s spare crown of ice, still croaking when nobody looks.

name: Crag Quill
blurb: A bronze quill the condor dropped, and it thinks it is a spear.

name: Ledge Feather
blurb: Drifts off every ledge and always finds its way back.

name: Updraft Fluff
blurb: A puff of cream neck fluff that rides the wind to see the view.

name: Talon Clutch
blurb: Four curled talons that grip the crag and never let go.

name: Nest Wobble
blurb: A twiggy nest on a cloud that sways in the wind and never quite falls off.

name: Grand Condor Plume
blurb: The biggest feather the Grand Condor ever dropped, and it still floats.

name: Pinfeather Hush
blurb: A soft brown feather that hushes anything trying to hoot.

name: Nightglow Fleck
blurb: A fleck of moon the owl dropped on the way home.

name: Aurora Thread
blurb: A green and purple thread the owl wears like a scarf.

name: Owlet Peep
blurb: A sleepy owlet in the den who peeps when it is bored.

name: Snowcrag Halo
blurb: A round snowy hollow where the owlets nap under the aurora.

name: Great White Plumelet
blurb: The great white owl’s finest feather, dipped in aurora light.

name: Scalecrust Tot
blurb: A tiny scale that flakes off every time it laughs.

name: Tongue Flicker
blurb: A forked red tongue that flicks at flies and misses on purpose.

name: Tail Tick
blurb: Ticks its tail against every rock on the path just to hear it.

name: Diamond Spur
blurb: Four diamond bumps off the lizard’s back, very proud of their pattern.

name: Karst Yawn
blurb: A scrap of the dark den mouth that yawns whenever the lizard does.

name: Mossback Monitor
blurb: A pocket-sized monitor lizard, polished by a hundred jungle naps.

name: Ember Flake
blurb: A cinder that drifted off the wyrm’s back and stayed warm.

name: Slag Drip
blurb: A thick glowing drip that takes its time falling off the forge.

name: Scorch Sliver
blurb: A sharp red sliver that still smells faintly of smoke.

name: Spine Spark
blurb: Four little spikes that pop like sparklers when stepped on.

name: Ash Wreath
blurb: A hollow wreath of cool grey ash that still hopes for a fire.

name: Last Forge Flame
blurb: The wyrm’s last little flame from the forge, curled up and dreaming of dragons.

name: Silkthread Tuft
blurb: Spun from the spider’s worries and still a little bit sticky.

name: Web Snag
blurb: A loose thread of web that snags hats, then hands them back.

name: Buttress Tangle
blurb: A knot of silk tucked in the buttress roots, guarding a good hiding spot.

name: Eightlegs Clasp
blurb: Eight spider legs that hold on tight and wiggle.

name: Dewweb Eye
blurb: A round gap in the web, ringed with morning dew that sparkles.

name: Silverback Spool
blurb: The big spider’s spare spool, still humming its old web song.

name: Fang Chip
blurb: A chipped wolf fang that only growls when the moon is out.

name: Pawprint Cuff
blurb: A soft snow cuff with one perfect pawprint pressed into it.

name: Moonpale Mantle
blurb: A pale scrap of mantle that only glows under the full moon.

name: Crown Points
blurb: Four little golden points from the king’s old crown.

name: Howl Echo
blurb: A howl that rings around once and comes back a little smaller.

name: Grey Wolf Whistle
blurb: A whistle the king carried, and the wolves still answer it.

name: Lightning Pinch
blurb: A little claw of lightning that snaps at anyone who sneezes.

name: Shell Splinter
blurb: A bit of orange shell that rattles whenever the wind blows.

name: Gust Ribbon
blurb: A leaf ribbon that flutters around in a little circle.

name: Whirl Pincer
blurb: Four pincers spun into a whirl and stuck together.

name: Eye of the Storm
blurb: A calm round hole in the middle of a very loud wind.

name: Gale Islander
blurb: A pocket crab with a whole tiny island on its back, palm trees and all.

name: Wing Jot
blurb: A jade flake that falls off a wing and hums while it drifts.

name: Reedleg Cling
blurb: Holds onto the reeds with six tiny legs and will not let go.

name: Jade Shimmer
blurb: A sparkly green shimmer that gets everywhere on sunny days.

name: Jadewing Quartet
blurb: Four little wing bits that all want to go first.

name: Lantern Eye Pair
blurb: A pair of orange eyes that glow whenever the dragonfly flies.

name: Lotus Perch
blurb: A pink lotus where the jade dragon-fly naps, humming with its wingbeat.

name: Tentacle Wisp
blurb: A pink tentacle curl that sways to music nobody else can hear.

name: Clownfish Peek
blurb: A little striped fish that peeks out of the coral, then hides again.

name: Bell Bead
blurb: A tiny blue bell that only rings when the queen is near.

name: Gold Spike Tiara
blurb: Four gold spikes from a crown that is mostly bubbles.

name: Jellybell Porthole
blurb: A see-through porthole in the queen’s bell, her favourite window.

name: Little Box Queen
blurb: A box jelly as square as a cube who insists she is the queen.

name: Ashpuff Drifter
blurb: A puff of crater smoke that drifts off looking for a warmer hat.

name: Smokecap Button
blurb: A little grey mushroom from the crater’s edge that smells faintly of rain.

name: Ember Speckle
blurb: A yellow spot that slid off the sleeping salamander and still glows.

name: Caldera Prongs
blurb: Four warm rock prongs from the crater rim where the salamander curls up.

name: Smoke Ringlet
blurb: A round hole of smoke that the wind keeps trying to fill.

name: Sleepy Salamander
blurb: A pocket fire salamander that snores little smoke puffs in its sleep.

name: Frost Nibble
blurb: A sliver of snow that nibbles at the tip of your nose.

name: Acacia Sprig
blurb: A flat-top acacia sprig that always points toward the peak.

name: Snowmelt Trickle
blurb: A tiny trickle off the snowcrown that giggles all the way down.

name: Snowcrown Peaks
blurb: Four snowy points that poke up like the top of the mountain.

name: Lion Paw Pair
blurb: A pair of big soft lion paws that never stop waving hello.

name: Snowpeak Cub
blurb: A pocket mountain lion with a mane as fluffy as the peak’s snow.

name: Tiger Dust
blurb: A dusting of orange wing powder that tickles the nose.

name: Prayerflag Slip
blurb: A bright prayer flag scrap that flutters only when it feels nervous.

name: Temple Chip
blurb: A grey stone flake from the temple steps that loves being counted.

name: Tiger Wing Quad
blurb: Four orange and black wing bits that flap in four directions.

name: Moonhoop
blurb: A round moon hole the moth flutters through at night.

name: Tiger Moth Locket
blurb: A wing eyespot kept like a locket, glowing softly like a lantern.

name: Pyramid Speck
blurb: A tan speck of tomb dust that wants to be a tiny pyramid.

name: Scarab Glint
blurb: A teal shell chip with gold lines that catches the desert sun.

name: Dune Ticktock
blurb: A grain of dune sand that ticks like a clock and never tells the time.

name: Scarab Leg March
blurb: Four skinny legs that march back to the tomb each night.

name: Sundisk Window
blurb: A golden disk over the tomb door, with a hole for peeking at noon.

name: Sandlit Scarab Charm
blurb: A cart-sized beetle shrunk to a charm, its red jewel still blinking.

name: Tailtip Tickle
blurb: The tip of the anaconda’s tail, which pokes out of the creek to tickle any toe it finds.

name: Tongue Taster
blurb: Tastes every breeze with a forked tongue and reports back to nobody.

name: Creek Sipper
blurb: Sips the jungle creek one ripple at a time and burps out a bubble.

name: Scale Diamonds
blurb: Four diamond markings off the anaconda’s back that shine like wet creek pebbles.

name: Coil Nest
blurb: The warm ring the anaconda curls into, with just enough room in the middle for a gnome nap.

name: Big Grin Anaconda
blurb: A huge anaconda coiled in the hollows creek, grinning from ear to ear, who only ever wants a hug.

name: Willow Chew
blurb: Chews one stick every morning and calls it breakfast in the lodge.

name: Paddletail Slap
blurb: Slaps the pond with a flat tail to say hello, goodbye and dinner time.

name: Tunnel Trickle
blurb: A trickle that runs the flooded tunnels under the lodge and never takes a wrong turn.

name: Damwall Logs
blurb: Four stubby logs off the dam, piled crooked, that creak when a beaver leans on them.

name: Lodge Door
blurb: The low round door of the lodge at the waterline, always open to a friend who can swim.

name: Dam Captain
blurb: A beaver captain whose flat tail keeps time for the whole dam while it chews.

name: Glowtail Dot
blurb: A firefly dot with a glowing tail that blinks on and off on purpose.

name: Canoe Glimmer
blurb: The little lamp on the outrigger canoe, which the fireflies think is a long-lost aunt.

name: Lake Twinkle
blurb: A firefly’s reflection that fell into the cave lake and keeps blinking from underneath.

name: Spare Wings
blurb: Four spare firefly wings in a neat stack, all of them fluttering at once.

name: Night Archway
blurb: The round far mouth of the cave, where the moonlit night peeks in to count the fireflies.

name: Firefly Lamplighter
blurb: A big chibi firefly who lights the cave one blink at a time and calls itself a star.

name: Firelily Flicker
blurb: A fire lily that pops up orange from the ash, as if the flames left a present behind.

name: Ash Sprout
blurb: A green sprout that pops up through the ash the week after the fire.

name: Charcoal Twiglet
blurb: A charred fynbos twig with one ember still glowing at its tip, like a sleepy candle.

name: Protea Petals
blurb: A king protea as big as a dassie’s head, with pink petals pointing every way at once.

name: Sunset Gap
blurb: A gap in the smoke where the dusk sun peeks over the ridge before bed.

name: Trail Dassie
blurb: A chibi rock dassie sitting on the ash trail, sniffing a protea as if it were cake.

name: Rosette Nub
blurb: A spotty rosette the jaguar lost in the root tangle, still purring.

name: Rootlet Swing
blurb: Swings from a hanging root over the cave path and drops onto the jaguar’s nose for fun.

name: Glowcap Nibble
blurb: A glow mushroom from the twisty side tunnel that lights the jaguar’s way to bed.

name: Softpad Prints
blurb: Four soft paw prints pressed into the root path, all pointing at the sunny cave mouth.

name: Sunspill Arch
blurb: The round sunlit mouth of the cave, where the jaguar sits to warm its whiskers.

name: Boulder Jaguar
blurb: A chibi jaguar curled on its mossy boulder, guarding the twisty path with a very serious purr.

name: Tidewater Toes
blurb: Dips its toes off the stilt roots at low tide and calls it a bath.

name: Frog Peeper
blurb: Peeks out from the mossy log between the roots and blinks at every bug.

name: Jarlight Twig
blurb: A firefly in a glass jar on a twig, held up high so the frog never loses the way.

name: Stiltroot Prance
blurb: Four knobbly stilt roots that hold up the whole tree and still dance with the tide.

name: Tangle Gap
blurb: The round gap in the tangled roots where the warm sky shows through; only a frog fits.

name: Mazeroot Mangrove
blurb: A little mangrove that grew its roots into a maze over the dark water and forgot the way out.

name: Hat Brim
blurb: Tips a tiny pirate hat at every passing wave and never once falls off.

name: Squawk Shanty
blurb: Sings sea shanties in a squawk so loud the fish come up to listen.

name: Stalactite Tap
blurb: Taps the grotto stalactites in a rhythm the whole sunny cove can dance to.

name: Loot Heap
blurb: A heap of pinched gold coins that clinks four ways whenever a gull sits on it.

name: Pinched Pearls
blurb: A stolen pearl necklace looped round and round, which the gulls take turns wearing.

name: Quartermaster Gull
blurb: A pirate gull in a tricorn hat who counts the loot twice and the fish three times.

name: Bunting Flag
blurb: One flag off the bunting strung across the gorge, snapping in the warm wind.

name: Window Peek
blurb: A little lamp-lit window carved in the canyon wall, peeking out at the camel.

name: Rosestone Pillar
blurb: A rose-pink column on the carved facade that hums whenever a breeze plays across it.

name: Saddle Stripes
blurb: Four bright stripes off the camel’s woven saddle blanket, each one a different sunset.

name: Lamplit Doorway
blurb: The dark carved doorway of the canyon city, with one lamp left on for late visitors.

name: Rose Canyon Camel
blurb: A chibi camel resting on the warm canyon sand in its striped blanket, in no hurry at all.

name: Brass Hardhat
blurb: A tiny lamp helmet that clinks against the salt ceiling every time it nods.

name: Salt Lick
blurb: Licks the salty walls and claims they taste like soup.

name: Crystal Pendant
blurb: A carved salt crystal off the chandelier that tinkles whenever a cart goes by.

name: Railtrack Rattle
blurb: Four iron rail ends that rattle like a drum roll as the cart rolls past.

name: Salthall Roundel
blurb: The round lit window of a carved gnome hall, warm as a bun from the oven.

name: Saltblock Minecart
blurb: A little mine cart piled with salt blocks that rumbles down the galleries and sings at every bend.

name: Clifftop Lamp
blurb: The little hut light on the clifftop that blinks once for all clear.

name: Sack Snooze
blurb: A lumpy sack aboard the rowboat that snores through every wave.

name: Lantern Wink
blurb: A hooded lantern that winks at the coast guard and then at the cave.

name: Tide Notches
blurb: Four notches on the tide pole that tell the rowboat when the sea cave is safe to enter.

name: Deepcave Glow
blurb: The warm round glow deep in the sea cave, where the lantern light waits for the boat.

name: Moonlit Keg
blurb: A keg on the tide ledge that hides a moonbeam and sneaks it past the coast guard.

name: Cairn Stack
blurb: A tower of grey stones under the wool pennants that wobbles but never quite falls over.

name: Ledge Hop
blurb: Hops up the switchback ledges on tiny paws and never looks down.

name: Ichu Whisker
blurb: A tuft of golden ichu grass on the cliff that tickles the leopard’s nose.

name: Woolly Pennants
blurb: Four woven wool pennants on the cairn pole, flapping in four mountain colours.

name: Snowcap Scoop
blurb: The snowy tip of the far peak, which the leopard swears is a giant scoop of ice cream.

name: Fluffytail Snow Leopard
blurb: A fluffy snow leopard curled up in its own long tail on the ledge, purring like a little avalanche.

name: Dawnleaf Drift
blurb: An orange walnut leaf that drifts off the canopy and lands on the same plank every dawn.

name: Plank Skipper
blurb: Skips every other plank of the high rope bridge and waves to the sheep below.

name: Yurt Kettle
blurb: A kettle in the tiny valley yurt that whistles whenever the bridge creaks.

name: Bridge Knots
blurb: Four fat rope knots tying the bridge to the trunks, each one tied by a different marmot.

name: Treetop Porch
blurb: A round platform on the trunk where the wind sits down for a rest.

name: Bridgewalk Marmot
blurb: A chibi marmot crossing the high rope bridge with a walnut held up like a prize.

name: Sentry Straw
blurb: A straw hat tied on with red cord that keeps watch on the wall and never blows away.

name: Brick Counter
blurb: Counts every brick on the long wall, then starts again to be sure.

name: Autumn Flutter
blurb: An autumn leaf riding the gale along the wall, never once touching the stones.

name: Battlement Whistle
blurb: Four stubby battlements in a row that the wind plays like a flute.

name: Galeswing Lantern
blurb: A round red lantern on the watchtower that swings sideways in the gale and never goes out.

name: Lookout Turret
blurb: A pocket watchtower that keeps the wall honest and the birds good company.

name: Dotted Trail
blurb: A trail of painted dots that sings the kangaroo the way home.

name: Galah Chatter
blurb: A pink galah that chatters all the way across the desert and never runs out of gossip.

name: Hummed Note
blurb: A little gold song note that floats off the songline and hums until it finds its place again.

name: Dotcircle Painting
blurb: Rings of painted dots on the boulder that tell the story of the whole songline.

name: Monolith Hidey
blurb: A small cave in the side of the great red rock where the kangaroo hides from the noon sun.

name: Songline Kangaroo
blurb: A little kangaroo wayfarer who points a paw along the song and hops the whole way home.

name: Tent Flap
blurb: The red flag on top of the tent, waving at the aurora to say the camp is open for the night.

name: Spark Hop
blurb: Hops off the campfire and floats up to join the aurora for a little dance before bed.

name: Pine Watch
blurb: A pine tree at the edge of camp that keeps watch through the snowy night and never nods off.

name: Aurora Band
blurb: A green ribbon of aurora that rolls over the snowy mountains and drapes itself across the sky.

name: Peak Peep
blurb: A tiny snowy mountain peak that peeks out under the aurora to say good night to the campers.

name: Nightcap Fox
blurb: A cosy little fox curled up by the camp, who wraps its tail around the warmest spot of the night.

name: Pot Simmer
blurb: A clay pot of stew on the step, kept warm for whichever traveller comes in late.

name: Branch Bird
blurb: A bird on the baobab branch that sings every guest awake before the sun is up.

name: Supper Sun
blurb: The savanna sun sinking behind the baobab, which the guests treat as the signal for supper.

name: Canopy Rustle
blurb: A bushy knot of baobab leaves that rustles whenever a guest comes up the path.

name: Trunk Peephole
blurb: A round window in the trunk, glowing warm for anyone still out on the savanna.

name: Baobab Innkeeper
blurb: A baobab-shaped innkeeper with a glowing door, who welcomes every traveller with a friendly rustle.

name: Teapot Tilt
blurb: A little blue teapot that tips a bow to every cup before the first sip.

name: Sakura Flurry
blurb: A pink puff of sakura that drops one petal into every cup of tea served on the hill.

name: Fuji Bow
blurb: The snowy mountain across the valley, which the gnomes greet with a bow every dawn.

name: Lantern Bob
blurb: A round red lantern under the eaves, glowing for every guest climbing the hill path.

name: Roof Medallion
blurb: The round gold medallion on the teahouse roof, which catches the dawn sun before anything else.

name: Hilltop Teahouse
blurb: A little teahouse with curly eaves and a warm window, who waves at everyone on the hill path.

name: Pan Ting
blurb: The round steel pan on its stand, which rings a bright tune whenever the wind taps it.

name: Frond Nod
blurb: A palm frond on the left of the bar that nods along to the steel-pan music.

name: Dusk Lap
blurb: Waves at sunset that lap up the sand and tickle the bar’s toes between songs.

name: Thatch Ridge
blurb: The thatched roof of the beach bar, rippling in the breeze over the coconut cups.

name: Pink Porthole
blurb: A round pink window on the bar wall, glowing for guests who want a view of the sea.

name: Pinkhat Drummer
blurb: A chibi gnome in a pink pointed hat who drums out the beach-bar tune until the sun drops into the sea.

name: Groundnut Bubble
blurb: A groundnut stew bubbling in the big black pot, stirred by whichever gnome is hungriest.

name: Moon Croon
blurb: A crescent moon over the market that hums along with the drums until the night is over.

name: Clap Along
blurb: A gnome in a red hat who claps along to every beat of the drum circle, a bit off the rhythm.

name: Acacia Parasol
blurb: A flat acacia tree over the market, its crown spread out like a shady umbrella for the drummers.

name: Firelit Circle
blurb: The circle of gnomes around the fire, glowing warm where the stew simmers.

name: Hut Dweller
blurb: A round mud hut with a thatched roof and a lit doorway, who opens up for every late drummer.

name: Blooming Barge
blurb: A barge heaped with pink and orange blooms that drifts slowly along the lake each morning.

name: Bobbing Blooms
blurb: Orange marigolds floating on the water, bobbing gently and waiting to be strung into garlands.

name: Sunrise Snowcap
blurb: The snowy mountain at the far end of the lake, which the flower boats face at sunrise.

name: Petal Heap
blurb: A heap of pale flowers piled high in the boat, ready for the next garland order.

name: Temple Arch

name: Goldtip Twinkle
blurb: A little gold knob on top of a mossy stone, twinkling in the moonlight.

name: Lilac Sprinkle
blurb: Lilac flecks sprinkled over the grass ring, as if the night had spilled some stars.

name: Mosscap Toppers
blurb: Green mossy caps sitting on the tall stones like cosy woolly hats.

name: Buttercream Moonlight
blurb: A round buttercream moon over the hill, which the stones all turn to face.

name: Hollowtop Menhir
blurb: A chibi standing stone with a mossy cap and a little dark hollow on top, humming softly at dusk.

name: Grumpy Mossmask
blurb: A round carved face with leafy ears and big round eyes, grumbling kindly at climbers.

name: Glyph Doodle
blurb: Little triangles and squares carved along the terrace, the temple’s old doodles.

name: Marigold Dot Duo
blurb: Orange and pink flowers in the grass, nodding together at the temple’s foot.

name: Ziggurat Zigzag
blurb: A zigzag of stone terraces that climbs up to the temple door.

name: Goldseal Gleam
blurb: A round gold medallion on the temple roof, shining over the whole climb.

name: Scarlet Riddlecaller
blurb: A chibi scarlet macaw on the top terrace, calling every riddle out loud for the climbers.

name: Lollipop Maple
blurb: A round red maple on the hillside, like a lollipop stuck in the grass.

name: Hilltop Bowl Shimmer
blurb: A little gold bowl on the hilltop shrine, catching the first rays of the sun.

name: Torii Tophat
blurb: The dark roof of the nearest red gate, tipped like a great black hat.

name: Redgate Staircase
blurb: Red gates stepping up the hillside one after another, each a little smaller.

name: Dawnglow Pearl
blurb: A big pale sun rising over the hill, its light spilling onto every gate.

name: Whisker Sentinel
blurb: A chibi shrine cat with a red collar, sitting very still beside the path and watching every climber.

name: Redcap Speck
blurb: A tiny red mushroom with white spots on the stump’s edge, proud as can be.

name: Leaf Raft
blurb: A green leaf lying on the rings like a little raft on a wooden pond.

name: Cellar Apple Gleam
blurb: A red apple tucked in a doorway under the stump, glowing in the dark.

name: Looking Glass Sparkle
blurb: A golden magnifying glass left on the rings, ready to count every year.

name: Velvet Hollow
blurb: The dark hollow in the middle of the stump, soft as velvet and full of tiny glints.

name: Tuftear Chipmunk
blurb: A chibi chipmunk with big tufty ears and purple socks, holding a little white orb on top of the stump.

name: Cinnamon Puff Bounce
blurb: Round grey puffs bouncing up from the crater, scented like warm cinnamon buns.

name: Spiced Bun Snooze
blurb: A warm spiced bun on the market ground, snoozing in the sun.

name: Podtree Wiggle
blurb: A tall pod-covered spice tree, wiggling its red-dotted branches in the breeze.

name: Pinkpetal Rows
blurb: Rows of pink flowers striping the terrace, planted one tidy stripe at a time.

name: Cratermouth Hearth
blurb: The warm orange glow of the crater, snug as a hearth on top of the mountain.

name: Sunhat Spicer
blurb: A chibi gnome with a straw cone hat and a brown beard, gathering spice for the market below.
